title: Average sales per store by region
objective: Calculate the average per store for each region with AVERAGEIF and compare one region with the overall average.
instructions: The sales list is in A1:C11. In F2:F4, use AVERAGEIF to find the average Sales (K) per store for the region named in E2:E4. Fix both ranges with $ signs and point the criteria at the region cell. In F5, use AVERAGE to find the average of all ten stores. In F6, subtract the all-store average (F5) from the Nairobi average (F2). Do not round; the answers may have decimals.
hints: AVERAGEIF has three parts: =AVERAGEIF(where to look, what to match, what to average).
For F2 look in the Region column ($B$2:$B$11), match E2 and average the Sales column ($C$2:$C$11). Copy the pattern for F3 and F4.
F5 is =AVERAGE(C2:C11), which ignores the regions. F6 is a simple subtraction: =F2-F5.
